verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph, which the docs present as the single API for OneDrive files, documents change notifications that alert applications when a resource is created, updated or deleted. The evidence does not tie these notifications explicitly to driveItems, and it says nothing about verification or retry. Delta query is pull-based change tracking, not push delivery, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit driveItem/OneDrive subscription docs, webhook validation/verification handshake, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, file events push to me — documented webhooks/change notifications fire when content changes, with verification and retry semantics spelled out

citations.quote: Change notifications enable applications to receive alerts when a Microsoft Graph resource they're interested in changes; that is, created, updated, or deleted.
with Microsoft Graph, you can use a single API to work with them.
